purpose: The cases Sean's 10,000-character input limit forces (docs/plan.md, decision 6), added beside eval05-inputs.json, which stays as pinned. Written on 12 November 2026, after the lead's first feasibility run, so these were not pinned before any candidate ran. They hold no new text: each is the start of eval05-inputs.json's prose, which is ASCII, so each byte is one character.
content: long holds the largest input the limit accepts and the smallest it refuses. cancellation and worker_loss replace eval05-inputs.json's, whose 16,384 characters the limit now refuses before any call, so they would cancel or kill nothing; each keeps its own timing.
